turns.content: The cylinder slows from 3.40 rad/s^2 to 2.00 rad/s while turning through 20.0 revolutions.
Convert the angular displacement to seconds.
Under the stated constant-change assumption, write a relation among the initial value, final value, and accumulated third quantity, then isolate the requested change parameter.
Substitute the values established above, calculate the requested quantity, and interpret its sign.
Check the conversion used above, numerator sign, and units in that relation.
